original_target.title: A closed Lagrangian Euler trajectory on a surface of higher genus

scope_comparison: Actual Problem10 concerns closed geodesics in the infinite-dimensional volume-preserving diffeomorphism group over higher-genus surfaces, not closed geodesics on the underlying surface. Generic surface-geodesic closing theorems and torus translations do not provide exact nontrivial particle-and-velocity recurrence for every higher-genus metric.
